name: 29184-codeedit-8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B, bf16, unquantized, ungated; complete in the local HF cache (5 safetensors shards, ~16.4 GB of weights).
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of one a3 node).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine, no sharding, no collectives.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=24, bounded at 240 requests / 1800 s safety, with a 10% warmup and 10% cooldown declared.
workload: guidellm `json_file` over `configs/data/blazedit-96.jsonl`: 96 code-edit prompts (a complete ~5.5k-character Python file plus a natural-language change request) pre-rendered from `vdaita/edit_5k_char` through the Qwen3-8B chat template. 969-2360 prompt tokens, median 1442, mean 1467. Every request generates EXACTLY 2000 tokens (`ignore_eos`), so every run does identical total work. `temperature: 0.0`, static seed 29184.
purpose: A code-editing assistant rewriting whole Python files for 24 concurrent developers, with long 2000-token edits on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM engine for 29184-codeedit-8b-1gpu, commit ee54f9cdb91f04350bba0cf11890b02b12c62baa.
# Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml, which is per-machine.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B

# MUST STAY ON ONE LINE AS INLINE JSON: an indented block mapping here parses as an empty value and
# the key is dropped whole, so the engine starts with no drafter, at rc=0.
speculative-config: {"method": "ngram", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "prompt_lookup_min": 2, "prompt_lookup_max": 2}

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 128
enable-chunked-prefill: true
trust-remote-code: true

# NOT a restated default -- this engine defaults it to true. The corpus is 96 rows against a
# 240-request bound, so the loop makes 2.5 passes over it; with caching on the later passes would
# prefill nearly free and the measured window would stop being one workload.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# The workload's worst case is a 2360-token prompt plus a 2000-token generation, so 8192 clears it
# and never binds. The checkpoint's own window is 40960.
max-model-len: 8192

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
